title: Maumau 2 times a week
author: Mendel J.
desc: Getting Maumau jacked beefy lean shredded

ss.note: Do Superset with Lateral Raise. Use light Dumbbells. Don't do to much rest between the exercises. Maybe do it upstairs to have the Dumbbells next to the machine.
Do Superset with Tricep Pushdown. Use light weight. If you do not have 15kg or less, switch exercise to Dumbbell Curl.
Superset with Hit Abductor (Pushing Legs Outside).
Slightly lean forward during the exercise to engage butt more.
Do these either upstairs with the machine and in superset with the seated leg curl, or downstairs with the one with the weight plates and the lying down leg curl (next to the squat racks)
Go up fast and down slow. Get the stretch at the end when you go down.
